tldr: Heavy exploitation day: a China-linked APT's VMware vCenter zero-day, four new CISA KEV additions, and active attacks on Apache Roller, Java4Shell-vulnerable Java stacks, and a clustered Cisco Expressway flaw. Also: a Russian FSB-linked APT phishing campaign, an N-able cloud breach, and the EU Commission confirming an AI-assisted intrusion.

emerging.title: North Korea-aligned actor hides C2 inside Solana blockchain transactions
emerging.description: Cisco Talos details "UAT-12643" (low-confidence NK attribution), which targets crypto holders and VoIP users with a Go-based RAT and Python infostealer. Its malware fetches encrypted C2 server addresses from memo fields of public Solana transactions — a resilient "dead drop" technique that's very hard to take down.

emerging.title: Unpatched Windows flaw lets attackers run code from the lock screen
emerging.description: A newly disclosed, unpatched Windows issue ("FastUnlock," no CVE yet) lets someone with physical access to a locked PC abuse the Narrator screen reader's recovery options to launch programs under a limited account — and read BitLocker-protected drives if TPM auto-unlock is configured. No fix from Microsoft yet.

items.title: China-linked APT exploited VMware vCenter zero-day for two months
items.description: Mandiant/Google say "Armory Castle" (ex-UNC5221) exploited CVE-2026-123890, an unauthenticated vCenter Directory Service auth-bypass (CVSS 9.8), chaining it with a BeyondTrust zero-day to steal SAML signing keys and pivot to ESXi hosts. Patch now; no fix exists for EOL vCenter 7.0.

items.title: CISA adds four actively exploited flaws to KEV catalog
items.description: Verified directly against the KEV catalog: Apache Axis (CVE-2026-90436), Vanderbilt REDCap (CVE-2026-90817), Synology DSM (CVE-2024-10441) and BerriAI LiteLLM (CVE-2026-40217) were all added Nov 18. Federal agencies must patch three by Nov 21 and LiteLLM by Dec 2.

items.title: Apache Roller critical RCE under active attack
items.description: CVE-2026-129448 (CVSS 9.8), an unauthenticated deserialization flaw in Apache Roller's XML-RPC endpoint (versions 4.0.0–6.1.4), is being actively exploited. The Apache Software Foundation confirmed exploitation but hasn't disclosed targets. Fixed in Roller 6.1.6+ — patch immediately.

items.title: "Java4Shell" OpenJDK flaw triggers emergency patches, active scanning
items.description: CVE-2026-114938, a memory-corruption bug in OpenJDK's Base64 handling on AVX-512-capable CPUs, prompted emergency advisories from Cisco, Red Hat, Elastic, Atlassian and Jenkins. GreyNoise and Cloudflare observed active scanning within a day; a working exploit exists but no confirmed compromises yet.

items.title: "NGINX2Root" flaws leave ~9M exposed services at risk
items.description: F5 patched five critical NGINX flaws (CVSS 9.2, one dating to 2015) that could let attackers escalate to root. Public PoCs are circulating and Censys estimates ~9 million exposed services; no in-the-wild exploitation confirmed yet. Patch to 1.30.7/1.31.9.

items.title: Cisco Expressway flaw exploited days after PoC release
items.description: Threat-intel firm F6 says attackers breached a Russian organization's clustered Cisco Expressway systems via CVE-2026-76466 (CVSS 9.8, hardcoded-credential root RCE) shortly after a public PoC appeared. Fixed in X15.5.20, no workaround. (Confirmed by one outlet only.)

items.title: N-able breach disrupts email security platform for MSPs
items.description: Unknown attackers accessed a server hosting N-able's Mail Assure and SpamExperts platforms across three regions, taking the management portal, APIs and logging offline. N-able says core mail filtering continues and it has no evidence of customer data access. (Confirmed by one outlet only.)

items.title: Russian FSB-linked APT impersonates breach victim to hit second target
items.description: Google reports Star Blizzard (FSB-linked, aka Cold River) breached a US organization using stolen admin credentials and MFA-fatigue attacks, then impersonated that victim's employee over messaging apps to phish a second US organization and hijack Entra ID tokens.

items.title: European Commission confirms AI-assisted cyberattack
items.description: The EU Commission confirmed a cyberattack, first detected Oct 22, that knocked out internal payroll, leave and translation systems for over a week. CERT-EU says attackers used ARTEX, an open-source AI hacking platform that automates exploit discovery; no attribution given yet.

items.title: Last Scattered Spider defendant sentenced in US crypto-theft case
items.description: Tyler Buchanan, 24, received six years for wire fraud and identity theft tied to Scattered Spider's SIM-swapping/phishing campaign, which stole at least $11.6M in cryptocurrency from telecom and crypto-firm employees between 2021-2023. All five defendants are now sentenced.

action: Patch immediately: VMware vCenter (CVE-2026-123890, no workaround), Apache Axis/Roller, Java4Shell-affected Java/OpenJDK components, NGINX (1.30.7/1.31.9), and clustered Cisco Expressway (X15.5.20). CISA's federal deadline for three new KEV entries is Nov 21; LiteLLM is Dec 2.
